name: GDevelop
description: electron-updater. Extension/Asset store channel has no hash/sig.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: GDevelop's desktop app uses electron-updater, while the reviewed extension-store context prefetches registry metadata and carries each extension's URL and version into its installation/update state. This snapshot does not establish an artifact hash or signature check in that application context; delegated service and dependency controls remain unresolved.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than historical release re-verification; the extension-store service, downloaded artifact format, and delegated dependency enforcement were not audited, so a repository-wide absence of hash/signature controls is not established.

original_evidence.text: | GDevelop (Electron app updater) | github.com/4ian/GDevelop | Electron (electron-updater 6.3.9) | Y | Y (`autoUpdater.checkForUpdatesAndNotify()` with `autoDownload=true`, invoked from renderer via IPC, also runs on a background schedule) | Y (downloads installer, `autoUpdater.quitAndInstall()` installs and relaunches) | HTTPS via GitHub Releases (`publish: [{provider: "github"}]`) | Partial — electron-builder auto-generates `latest*.yml` with per-artifact SHA-512, fetched over HTTPS; no separate detached cryptographic signature on that manifest itself | hash-from-manifest (SHA-512, electron-builder-generated) + OS-code-signing (Windows Authenticode via signtool; macOS hardenedRuntime + entitlements + notarization) | Windows: cert referenced by `GD_SIGNTOOL_SUBJECT_NAME`/`GD_SIGNTOOL_THUMBPRINT` env vars (external signtool); macOS: Apple Developer ID cert used by `afterSign` notarization script | newIDE/electron-app/app/main.js:12 (`require('electron-updater').autoUpdater`), :741-742 (`autoUpdater.autoDownload = true; autoUpdater.checkForUpdatesAndNotify()`), :757 (`autoUpdater.quitAndInstall()`); newIDE/electron-app/electron-builder-config.js:11 (`publish:[{provider:'github'}]`), win.signtoolOptions / mac.hardenedRuntime block |

| GDevelop (Extension Store / Asset Store content channel) | github.com/4ian/GDevelop | Electron/React IDE | Y (content channel: extensions are JSON event-graphs compiled/executed by GDevelop's JS runtime; assets are mostly images/sounds) | N (user searches/installs manually) | Y (extensions); assets are largely non-executable media | HTTPS (`api.gdevelop.io/asset`, `api.gdevelop.io` extension registry, `asset-resources.gdevelop.io`, `private-assets.gdevelop.io`, etc. — all hardcoded https) | N | none found — no hash/signature check in install code, relies solely on HTTPS transport trust to GDevelop's own API/CDN | n/a | newIDE/app/src/Utils/GDevelopServices/ApiConfigs.js (all `https://` base URLs); newIDE/app/src/AssetStore/ExtensionStore/InstallExtension.js (fetches registry JSON directly, no hash field/check); newIDE/app/src/AssetStore/InstallAsset.js (no hash check in `installResource`) |
